settings.help_description: Answers, guides, and a way to reach us.
settings.help_faq_a1: Uptizm runs synthetic checks from multiple regions and watches your custom metrics. When checks fail or a metric breaches its band, it opens an incident, automatically or for your approval, depending on your team's AI mode.
settings.help_faq_a2: Team-level channels (email, SMS, Slack, Microsoft Teams, webhook) are set under your team's notification channels. Personal delivery (in-app, web push) is in your account notifications.
settings.help_faq_q3: Can the AI act on my infrastructure?
settings.help_faq_a3: No. Uptizm observes from the outside and only reasons from its own checks and your metrics. It suggests where to look and can manage the incident, but it never touches your systems.
settings.help_contact_note: We usually reply within a few hours.
settings.changelog_v240_new_1: Uptizm AI assistant: ask about your monitors or set things up from any screen.
settings.changelog_v240_new_2: Status page subscriptions with a subscriber list and custom logo upload.
settings.changelog_v240_improved_1: Per-monitor response charts now reflect each monitor's own baseline.
settings.changelog_v230_new_1: Notification channels: Slack, Microsoft Teams, SMS, and webhooks.
settings.changelog_v230_improved_1: Incident timeline now separates public updates from internal activity.
settings.changelog_v230_fixed_1: Dark mode contrast on the AI analysis card.
settings.changelog_v220_new_1: Custom metrics: point at your own endpoint and chart it under a monitor.
settings.changelog_v220_improved_1: Faster anomaly detection on regional latency.
settings.privacy_section_collect_text: Account details you provide (name, email), the monitors and metrics you configure, and the check results Uptizm gathers on your behalf. We don't collect data from inside your own systems.
settings.privacy_section_use_text: To run your monitors, detect and analyze incidents, deliver notifications through your chosen channels, and render your status pages. We never sell your data.
settings.privacy_section_sharing_text: We share only with the integrations you connect (e.g. Slack, your webhook endpoint) and the infrastructure providers that run the service. Status page subscribers receive only what you publish.
settings.privacy_section_retention_text: Check history and metrics are retained for your plan's window, then aggregated or deleted. You can delete a team at any time, which removes its monitors, incidents, and status pages.
settings.privacy_section_rights_text: You can access, export, or delete your personal data from your account settings, or by contacting us. We honor regional privacy rights including GDPR and CCPA.
settings.privacy_section_contact_text: Questions about privacy? Reach us at privacy@uptizm.com.
settings.terms_section_acceptance_text: By creating a team or using Uptizm, you agree to these terms. If you're using Uptizm for an organization, you confirm you're authorized to accept on its behalf.
settings.terms_section_using_text: Use Uptizm to monitor endpoints you own or are permitted to check. Don't use it to attack, overload, or probe systems without authorization.
settings.terms_section_data_text: You own the monitors, metrics, and content you create. You grant us the rights needed to operate the service on your behalf, as described in the Privacy Policy.
settings.terms_section_availability_text: We work hard to keep Uptizm reliable but provide it 'as is'. Planned maintenance is posted in advance on our own status page.
settings.terms_section_liability_text: To the extent permitted by law, Uptizm isn't liable for indirect or consequential damages. Monitoring is a safety net, not a guarantee against downtime.
settings.terms_section_changes_text: We may update these terms; material changes are announced in-app and via the changelog. Continued use means you accept the updated terms.
